name: THE ANATOMICAL COMPARTMENT LAW

physical.statement: Every intended skeletal bone/segment owns one sealed hydraulic compartment (operator correction 2026-09-13: "you can't just have four sections"). Treat this as Chimera's ENGINEERED anatomy, not a claim that biological bones are hermetic water bags.
physical.verification: verification: compartment count matches the bone count, every cell conserves, and a press on any bone answers in THAT bone's cell -- not a neighbor's
